note: Proposals only. None has been implemented in the five planning studies; choose a path before spending development or research time on it.

suggestions.title: Route the ≤60-minute test before choosing a hotel
suggestions.why: It is the only requirement that changes the hotel ranking and is still unverified: the existing model is straight-line with declared constants, not a road/network route.
suggestions.how: Pick the final 3–5 venues, run Amap or Baidu transit for each with the hotel address, and store the returned minutes with a timestamp.
suggestions.review_first: Confirm whether 60 minutes means door-to-door or station-to-station.

suggestions.title: Re-quote the shortlist on each hotel's own booking engine
suggestions.why: The four-plan comparison uses 25 Nov 2026 OTA snapshots; later root Beijing and dual-city pages contain separate 26 Nov snapshots. No hotel-direct re-quote was made here, and tax treatments differ.
suggestions.how: Use the exact dates and room category, save an all-in screenshot/PDF per hotel, and compare against these dated rows.
suggestions.review_first: Agree whether Genius/member rates are eligible.

suggestions.title: Resolve the $922 vs $1,116 Radisson gap
suggestions.why: Same hotel, same week, different room category and sign-in state; the difference is not a data error but it blocks a like-for-like recommendation.
suggestions.how: Hold the room type and sign-in state constant, re-quote both, and record bed and bathroom wording.
suggestions.review_first: Decide whether a Junior Suite is required.

suggestions.title: Close the hours and price cells by contacting venues
suggestions.why: Most restaurant rows have no official hours and no price for two, so an itinerary cannot be costed or sequenced reliably.
suggestions.how: Use the official phone/email/WeChat channel listed in each plan, ask for the Feb 2027 set menu and holiday hours, and paste the dated reply.
suggestions.review_first: Confirm who makes the calls and in which language.

suggestions.title: Extend the verified social index with Instagram and TikTok
suggestions.why: This pass verified YouTube pages only; the brief asked for YouTube, TikTok or Instagram. Platform pages for some brands are reachable but must be tied to an official source first.
suggestions.how: Start from each venue's own site or Guide entry, record the handle exactly as published, and flag any similarly named account.
suggestions.review_first: Decide whether third-party review accounts count, or only official venue accounts.

suggestions.title: Verify venue-specific holiday hours and closure notices
suggestions.why: The State Council holiday and makeup-workday dates are now confirmed from the Chinese official notice. Restaurant and attraction opening exceptions for the selected dates remain venue-specific and may change.
suggestions.how: Once city, dates and attractions are chosen, consult each official operator page or dated notice and record the source plus the date checked.
suggestions.review_first: Choose the city, exact stay dates and priority venues.

suggestions.title: Re-check the Guide edition immediately before booking
suggestions.why: The live Shanghai filter currently lists 50 starred venues, while the 2026 regional release says 156 Shanghai selections; the 2027 Shanghai edition was not located in this pass.
suggestions.how: Fetch the live filtered lists, record the edition year and counts, and only then enter a restaurant's status.
suggestions.review_first: Decide whether a 2027 Shanghai release would trigger a new plan.

suggestions.title: Publish a single all-in cost model
suggestions.why: No plan currently totals airfare, visas, city transport, VAT/service and dinners for the same itinerary.
suggestions.how: Add one row per category, with either an official quote or a blank flagged cell; never fill a gap with an average.
suggestions.review_first: Agree whether airfare from the traveller's home airport is in scope.

suggestions.title: Validate social-video scope against the exact branch
suggestions.why: Search results for T'ang Court resolve to Hong Kong, and Da Dong's city is right but its branch is not stated; a plausible link can point at a different restaurant.
suggestions.how: Open the video and read the description/transcript for the street, city or branch before adding it.
suggestions.review_first: Decide whether brand-level videos are useful at all.

suggestions.title: Choose one weighted decision rule
suggestions.why: Four single-city snapshots plus a separate dual-city planner use different scopes and ranking criteria; only the four 7-night single-city rows are comparable in this price table.
suggestions.how: Agree weights for price, bed compliance, star count, verified hours and travel time; apply the same weights to all plans and publish the arithmetic.
suggestions.review_first: Set weights before seeing which plan wins.
